newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's January-July trade deficit falls 10.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's January-July trade deficit falls 10.6 pct.

text.p: Peru's trade deficit fell 10.6 percent in the first seven months of the year to $1.047 billion from $1.171 billion in the same period last year, the Central Reserve Bank said Friday.
Exports grew 8.0 percent in the first seven months to $3.403 billion from $3.150 billion in the same period of 1995, the bank said in its weekly report.
Meanwhile in the January to July period imports rose 3.0 percent to $4.449 billion, compared with $4.321 billion in the same period last year, the bank said.
Peru's commercial deficit more than doubled to $2.115 billion in 1995 from $1.021 billion the previous year.
